lines.text: Four kings fought five, including the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah, who had been subject to Chedorlaomer for twelve years.
Some of Sodom's men fell into tar pits, and the four kings carried off Abram's nephew Lot.
Abram mobilized 318 trained men, pursued the four kings as far as Bethel, and brought back Lot and the goods.
Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, brought out milk and honey, blessed Abram, and received a tenth.
Abram refused to take even a thread from the king of Sodom, but said Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre could take their portion.
